posts.author: OtroNombreRaro1
posts.body:
Title:
SupportLink
Version:
1.3
Author:
OtroNombreRaro
Compatibility:
MV and MZ
Description:
This plugin for RPG Maker MV and MZ allows you to easily add visual support elements to your game's title screen. It displays one or two images: a clickable logo (which opens an external link), and an optional support message or banner. Ideal for encouraging donations, sharing project links, or inviting to Discord spaces.
It can be useful if your game on itch.io was previously set as "donation" but now you're required to mark it as "free" in order to publish it.
It also includes a plugin command that allows you to open a custom URL from within the game, giving you more options for the players can enter to you link.
Update 1.3:
Added more image logos by request (disable by default)
Update 1.2:
Now the plugin have a plugin command for use in game.
Update 1.1:
Now the plugin is fully compatible with Joiplay (thank to  [ g f y ] mod of Joiplay Discord for the help.)
Plugin Download:
Itch.io Page
Terms of use:
Free license.

posts.body:
Altered the plugin to use a struct so you can have any number of images. That simplified quite a bit of code.
If you supply a blank URL then it won't open the browser when clicked, which is what the Support Message thing was doing. Also fixed how it handles the Plugin Command part for MV and MZ.
I'm calling it version 2.0
